daily.today_energy: Your vibe is grounded but restless—like you're ready to level up. The universe is whispering that it's time to stop overthinking and start trusting your gut. Channel that steady Capricorn energy into something creative today.
daily.love: Someone's been thinking about you more than you realize. Whether it's deepening an existing connection or a random person noticing your quiet confidence, the energy suggests genuine interest. Stay open without forcing anything.
daily.career: Your attention to detail is your superpower right now. A project or conversation you thought was dormant might suddenly need your expertise. Trust that your work speaks for itself—recognition is closer than you think.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance between hustle and rest. Movement feels good today, but so does intentional downtime. Honor both impulses—maybe a walk that clears your head, or stretching while listening to something that makes you feel alive.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to soften your edges, Cap. You've been grinding hard, and the cosmos is gently suggesting it's time to let people in. Trust the process of vulnerability—it's actually your superpower right now.
weekly.love: Whether you're single or coupled up, authenticity is your love language this week. Stop overthinking what you 'should' feel and lean into what actually makes your heart skip. Real connections thrive when you show up as yourself.
weekly.career: Your work momentum is building, but the real magic happens when you collaborate instead of going solo. Share your ideas freely and watch how others elevate them. This is your week to shine through teamwork, not just hustle.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness. It's not about pushing harder—it's about consistency and actually enjoying movement. Find something that feels good rather than punishing. Your nervous system will thank you for the shift.
